title: DeepSeek Said to Tell Backers of Funding Pause After Viral Posts
description: DeepSeek has told prospective investors in its second fundraising round that it’s suspending the deal for now, people familiar with the matter said, days after comments widely attributed to founder Liang Wenfeng about US-Chinese AI competition went viral.

title: India’s Modi Adopts Reels Amid Instagram-Fueled Student Unrest
description: As student protests spread across India, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has turned to Meta Platforms Inc.’s Instagram Reels, swapping his trademark cinematic videos for raw, self-recorded messages aimed at the country’s youth.

title: Samsung Inks $200 Billion Chip Supply with Broadcom
description: Samsung Electronics Co. won a contract worth more than $200 billion to make chips for Broadcom Inc., as the companies race to win a larger share of the AI infrastructure market.
